payload: business/overview/index.yaml plus recursive business/srs/**/index.yaml leaves carrying extensions.work3.specification; branches aggregate.
completion: Review proof and current .starciwork validation only; never implementation, Sonar or UAT pass.
handoff: Architecture consumes accepted SRS leaf IDs, requirements, flows and acceptance unchanged, including inherited scope. No code/service design or implementation checks belong in Business.

action.en: Resolve the canonical .starciwork workspace and selected business leaf. Research accepted intent, domain documents and current FE/BE callers at exact revisions. Classify every citation as accepted intent, observed source, proposal or unknown; source behavior never approves policy.

Write purpose, scope/exclusions, glossary, assumptions, actors with responsibilities/rights/restrictions, FR/BR and observable NFRs. Specify business data attributes, validation, sensitivity, states/transitions and external inputs/outputs/errors. State why a data or external-interface inventory is empty. Source observations and supplied technical constraints are not approved business policy; unknown numeric targets retain a decision owner.

Every FR resolves to a detailed flow, not a title alone: trigger, primary/supporting actors, inputs, preconditions, numbered actor/request/system-response steps, guards, effects, failures, repeat behavior and success/failure postconditions. Alternative and exception branches identify their starting step, condition, ordered steps, resume/end and acceptance. Review denied/invalid input, cancellation, duplicate/retry, concurrency and recovery where relevant; explain absent branch classes without fabricating cases.

Review observable outcomes against accepted intent and observed behavior. Business states what users and the system must do, not class inheritance, repositories, service placement, Saga/CQRS, Kubernetes or backup tooling. Preserve genuinely supplied technical constraints as sourced external constraints; hand implementation questions to Architecture instead of encoding an invented design in requirements.

Specify actor-action-resource permissions, tenant/owner boundaries, sensitive-data handling and abuse cases. Give each security requirement an observable denial/no-side-effect acceptance scenario; do not mistake a disabled UI control for server enforcement.

Author business/overview/index.yaml with businessOverview for readable purpose, customer understanding, outcome, scope and open questions. Author the sole detailed SRS in extensions.work3.specification using starci/specification@2 on cohesive business/srs/**/index.yaml leaves. Intermediate folders are metadata-only aggregates; scale by adding folders, not editing a registry or duplicating a monolithic SRS. Stable FR/BR/NFR/flow/AC IDs and explicit core refs/dependsOn provide traceability. Do not repeat the detailed SRS in a compact business object. Preserve canonical user journeys and never turn internal service hops into UI actions.

Validate detailed requirement/flow/branch/acceptance coverage and the recursive Work graph. Review contradictions, scope and unresolved decisions with the user. A complete branch rolls up only from valid required leaves; draft placeholders and schema validity cannot earn done. Output reviewed business outcomes and observable security/quality acceptance for Architecture; no implementation or deployed-proof claim.

layout: business/index.yaml aggregates overview/index.yaml and srs/index.yaml; add cohesive folders recursively under srs with no registry. Branches have no stored state or SRS; leaves own complete SRS. Legacy accepted records remain readable without automatic migration.
